**Implementation note:** Labels only; no classifier trained on them.

## Description

Labels candidate trades by which event occurs first: profit target, stop-loss barrier or time limit, then trains a classifier or ranker on those outcomes.

## Where it may fit

Filtering primary signals when trade outcomes depend on volatility-scaled upside, downside and holding horizon.

## Vehicles

Equity, futures, FX and crypto systematic strategies; often a research pipeline component.

## Required data

Timestamped price paths, primary signal timestamps/directions, volatility estimates, target/stop/time barriers, costs and outcome labels.

## Caveats

This is a labeling method rather than a complete strategy; labels must use only information available after each event and validation must respect overlapping labels.
